name: Homepage loads successfully
description: Open target_url in headless Chrome; assert page title contains 'Fidato' and the hero H1 'Content Creation, AI Audio Scoring, & Enterprise Systems Architecture.' is visible.
expected_result: HTTP load with no error page; title contains 'Fidato'; h1.hero present and visible.

name: Primary navigation renders with all 8 section links
description: Assert nav[aria-label='Main Navigation'] exists and contains links: Home, Art & Content, AI Music & Audio, Architecture, Resume, Credentials, Media Assets, Contact.
expected_result: All 8 nav links present and displayed with correct hrefs.

name: Each internal section link resolves (no broken routes)
description: Parametrized over /art, /music, /architecture, /resume, /credentials, /media, /contact: navigate and assert the resulting page does not show a 404/'Page not found' and has a non-empty <body>.
expected_result: Every section route loads a real page (no 404), non-empty body text.

name: Hero CTA 'Explore My Work' navigates to /art
description: Click the hero CTA in div.hero-ctas and assert the URL becomes /art and the Art page content renders.
expected_result: URL ends with /art and page body is non-empty.

name: Hero CTA 'View Resume' navigates to /resume
description: Click the hero 'View Resume' button (a.btn.btn-ghost) and assert URL becomes /resume.
expected_result: URL ends with /resume and resume content renders.

name: Footer SITE SECTIONS links are valid
description: Enumerate footer.footer-links anchors and assert each has a href and resolves to a non-404 page.
expected_result: All footer section links have hrefs and resolve successfully.

name: Contact / Commission Work CTA reaches /contact
description: Click the navbar 'Commission Work' CTA (a.cta-nav-btn) and the 'Contact' nav link; assert both land on /contact.

name: External links are well-formed and open in new tab
description: Assert known external links (Main Portfolio nxtdev.xyz, Visual Art Portfolio nxtdev.xyz, Suno @fidato_warrior, Medium, Credly badges) exist with valid https hrefs.
expected_result: All external anchors present with https hrefs and target=_blank where applicable.

name: No broken images on homepage
description: Iterate all elements and assert naturalWidth > 0 (no failed loads).

name: Unknown route returns 404 page
description: Navigate to a non-existent path (e.g. /this-page-does-not-exist) and assert the site returns a 404 / 'Page not found' response rather than silent blank page.
expected_result: Unknown path yields a 404 status or an explicit not-found page.

name: Mobile viewport renders hero and nav
description: Load homepage at 390x844 (iPhone-ish). Assert the hero h1 and nav container are present and the page body is non-empty.
expected_result: Hero and navigation present and visible at mobile width.
